root_idea.summary: The root denotes forceful overcoming, domination, and compelling another against resistance.
root_idea.development: Its meanings develop from coercive force and overpowering to names for powerful beings or agents associated with overcoming, including قَسْوَرَةٌ in its Quranic interpretations as a lion or as hunters and shooters.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized nominal citation form قَسْوَرَة.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression describing the fleeing asses, interpreted as a lion because it overcomes and overpowers.

senses.definition: A hunter or shooter who casts missiles; hunters or shooters collectively.
senses.usage_conditions: In the same Quranic expression, an alternative interpretation of قَسْوَرَةٌ as those who hunt or shoot, causing the asses to flee.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compel or force someone to do something against his will.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى to express forcing someone to undertake an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome, overpower, subdue, or oppress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader use describing domination or defeat by force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain sour, grasslike plant growing in plains or soft land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plant is described as eagerly eaten by camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mighty or overpowering; strong and courageous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The strong and courageous application is specifically given of a man; the overpowering sense is broader.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sound, voices, or cries of men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective auditory meaning referring to human voices or calls.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers compelling against the will and overpowering or subduing.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry.
Defines قَسْوَرٌ and قَسْوَرَةٌ as a plant.
Defines قَسْوَرَةٌ as mighty, overpowering, strong, and courageous.
Gives the Quranic hunters and shooters interpretation.
Defines the word as the sound or voices of men.

cautions: قَسْوَرَةٌ in 74:51 has two explicitly attested Quranic interpretations in the supplied evidence: a lion, or hunters and shooters; the evidence does not resolve the alternative.
